algorithm: approved OpenHands product-mechanics scope -> surgical domain/runtime removal -> actual local import closure verification

classification_legend.REQUIRED_VENDOR: Core Agent Product mechanic — vendored as part of source adoption.
classification_legend.REQUIRED_TRANSITIVE: Real import dependency of REQUIRED_VENDOR — vendored with parent.
classification_legend.EXCLUDED: Outside the single Workspace dependency closure or prohibited product surface — never enters the vendored source tree.
classification_legend.DEFERRED_NOT_VENDORED: Upstream exists, no current consumer — vendored only when a consuming integration requires it.

scope_contract: files contains the adopted mechanics plus representative excluded boundaries; source-policy remains authoritative for the complete excluded-domain inventory.
